verses.original: וַיְהִ֡י בְּאַרְבַּע֩ עֶשְׂרֵ֨ה שָׁנָ֜ה לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ חִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ עָלָ֞ה סַנְחֵרִ֤יב מֶֽלֶךְ־ אַשּׁוּר֙ עַ֣ל כָּל־ עָרֵ֧י יְהוּדָ֛ה הַבְּצֻר֖וֹת וַֽיִּתְפְּשֵֽׂם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bə·’ar·ba‘ ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh lam·me·leḵ ḥiz·qî·yā·hū ‘ā·lāh san·ḥê·rîḇ me·leḵ- ’aš·šūr ‘al kāl- ‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh hab·bə·ṣu·rō·wṯ way·yiṯ·pə·śêm
verses.literal: In the fourteenth . . . year of Hezekiah’s reign Sennacherib king of Assyria . . . attacked and captured all the fortified cities of Judah
verses.literalPt: Ora, no décimo quarto ano do rei Ezequias, subiu Senaqueribe, rei da Assíria, contra as cidades fortificadas de Judá e as tomou.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח מֶֽלֶךְ־ אַשּׁ֣וּר׀ אֶת־ רַב־ שָׁקֵ֨ה מִלָּכִ֧ישׁ יְרוּשָׁלְַ֛מָה אֶל־ הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ בְּחֵ֣יל כָּבֵ֑ד וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֗ד בִּתְעָלַת֙ הַבְּרֵכָ֣ה הָעֶלְיוֹנָ֔ה בִּמְסִלַּ֖ת שְׂדֵ֥ה כוֹבֵֽס׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ me·leḵ- ’aš·šūr ’eṯ- raḇ- šā·qêh mil·lā·ḵîš yə·rū·šā·lə·māh ’el- ham·me·leḵ ḥiz·qî·yā·hū bə·ḥêl kā·ḇêḏ way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ biṯ·‘ā·laṯ hab·bə·rê·ḵāh hā·‘el·yō·w·nāh bim·sil·laṯ śə·ḏêh ḵō·w·ḇês
verses.literal: And the king of Assyria sent the Rabshakeh with a great army from Lachish to King Hezekiah at Jerusalem And he stopped by the aqueduct of the upper pool on the road to the Launderer’s Field
verses.literalPt: O rei da Assíria enviou de Laquis a Jerusalém ao rei Ezequias Rabsaqué com um grande exército. Este parou junto ao aqueduto da piscina superior no caminho do campo do lavandeiro.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֥א אֵלָ֛יו אֶלְיָקִ֥ים בֶּן־ חִלְקִיָּ֖הוּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ הַבָּ֑יִת וְשֶׁבְנָא֙ הַסֹּפֵ֔ר וְיוֹאָ֥ח בֶּן־ אָסָ֖ף הַמַּזְכִּֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê ’ê·lāw ’el·yā·qîm ben- ḥil·qî·yā·hū ’ă·šer ‘al- hab·bā·yiṯ wə·šeḇ·nā has·sō·p̄êr wə·yō·w·’āḥ ben- ’ā·sāp̄ ham·maz·kîr
verses.literal: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah the palace administrator Shebna the scribe and Joah son of Asaph the recorder went out to him
verses.literalPt: Então, saíram a ter com ele Eliaquim, filho de Hilquias, mordomo, Sebna, secretário, e Joá, filho de Asafe, cronista-mor.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם֙ רַב־ שָׁקֵ֔ה אִמְרוּ־ נָ֖א אֶל־ חִזְקִיָּ֑הוּ כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֞ר הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ הַגָּדוֹל֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר מָ֧ה הַבִּטָּח֛וֹן הַזֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּטָֽחְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem raḇ- šā·qêh ’im·rū- nā ’el- ḥiz·qî·yā·hū kōh- ’ā·mar ham·me·leḵ hag·gā·ḏō·wl me·leḵ ’aš·šūr māh hab·biṭ·ṭā·ḥō·wn haz·zeh ’ă·šer bā·ṭā·ḥə·tā
verses.literal: The Rabshakeh said to them Tell . . . . . . Hezekiah that this is what the great king the king of Assyria says What is the basis of this confidence of yours
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhes Rabsaqué: Dizei a Ezequias: Assim diz o grande rei, o rei da Assíria: Que confiança é essa em que te estribas?

verses.original: אָמַ֙רְתִּי֙ אַךְ־ דְּבַר־ שְׂפָתַ֔יִם עֵצָ֥ה וּגְבוּרָ֖ה לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה עַתָּה֙ עַל־ מִ֣י בָטַ֔חְתָּ כִּ֥י מָרַ֖דְתָּ בִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·mar·tî ’aḵ- də·ḇar- śə·p̄ā·ṯa·yim ‘ê·ṣāh ū·ḡə·ḇū·rāh lam·mil·ḥā·māh ‘at·tāh ‘al- mî ḇā·ṭaḥ·tā kî mā·raḏ·tā bî
verses.literal: You claim to have a strategy and strength for war but these are empty words In whom are you now trusting that you have rebelled against me
verses.literalPt: Digo, o teu conselho e poder para a guerra são tão somente palavras vãs. Em quem, pois, agora, confias, visto que hás rebelado contra mim?

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה בָטַ֡חְתָּ עַל־ מִשְׁעֶנֶת֩ הַקָּנֶ֨ה הָרָצ֤וּץ הַזֶּה֙ עַל־ מִצְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִסָּמֵ֥ךְ אִישׁ֙ עָלָ֔יו וּבָ֥א בְכַפּ֖וֹ וּנְקָבָ֑הּ כֵּ֚ן פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרַ֔יִם לְכָֽל־ הַבֹּטְחִ֖ים עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ḇā·ṭaḥ·tā ‘al- miš·‘e·neṯ haq·qā·neh hā·rā·ṣūṣ haz·zeh ‘al- miṣ·ra·yim ’ă·šer yis·sā·mêḵ ’îš ‘ā·lāw ū·ḇā ḇə·ḵap·pōw ū·nə·qā·ḇāh kên par·‘ōh me·leḵ- miṣ·ra·yim lə·ḵāl hab·bō·ṭə·ḥîm ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: Look now you are trusting in Egypt that splintered reed of a staff that will pierce the hand of anyone who leans on it Such is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust in him
verses.literalPt: Eis que confias no Egito, no bordão desse caniço esmagado, sobre o qual, se o homem se firmar, ele se lhe meterá pela mão e a traspassará; assim é Faraó, rei do Egito, para todos os que nele confiam.

verses.original: וְכִי־ תֹאמַ֣ר אֵלַ֔י אֶל־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ בָּטָ֑חְנוּ הֲלוֹא־ ה֗וּא אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵסִ֤יר חִזְקִיָּ֙הוּ֙ אֶת־ בָּמֹתָ֣יו וְאֶת־ מִזְבְּחֹתָ֔יו וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לִֽיהוּדָה֙ וְלִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לִפְנֵ֛י הַמִּזְבֵּ֥חַ הַזֶּ֖ה תִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- ṯō·mar ’ê·lay ’el- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū bā·ṭā·ḥə·nū hă·lō·w- hū ’ă·šer hê·sîr ḥiz·qî·yā·hū ’eṯ- bā·mō·ṯāw wə·’eṯ- miz·bə·ḥō·ṯāw way·yō·mer lî·hū·ḏāh wə·lî·rū·šā·lim lip̄·nê ham·miz·bê·aḥ haz·zeh tiš·ta·ḥă·wū
verses.literal: But if you say to me We trust in the LORD our God is He not the One whose high places and altars Hezekiah has removed saying to Judah and Jerusalem You must worship before this altar
verses.literalPt: Mas, se me disseres: Confiamos em Jeová, nosso Deus, não é este aquele cujos altos e altares Ezequias tirou, dizendo a Judá e a Jerusalém: Diante deste altar adorareis?

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ הִתְעָ֣רֶב נָ֔א אֶת־ אֲדֹנִ֖י הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֑וּר וְאֶתְּנָ֤ה לְךָ֙ אַלְפַּ֣יִם סוּסִ֔ים אִם־ תּוּכַ֕ל לָ֥תֶת לְךָ֖ רֹכְבִ֥ים עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hiṯ·‘ā·reḇ nā ’eṯ- ’ă·ḏō·nî ham·me·leḵ ’aš·šūr wə·’et·tə·nāh lə·ḵā ’al·pa·yim sū·sîm ’im- tū·ḵal lā·ṯeṯ lə·ḵā rō·ḵə·ḇîm ‘ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: Now, therefore make a bargain . . . with my master the king of Assyria I will give you two thousand horses if you can put riders on them
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, dá penhores ao rei da Assíria, meu amo, e dar-te-ei dois mil cavalos, se da tua parte puderes achar homens para montar neles.

verses.original: וְאֵ֣יךְ תָּשִׁ֗יב אֵ֠ת פְּנֵ֨י פַחַ֥ת אַחַ֛ד עַבְדֵ֥י אֲדֹנִ֖י הַקְטַנִּ֑ים וַתִּבְטַ֤ח לְךָ֙ עַל־ מִצְרַ֔יִם לְרֶ֖כֶב וּלְפָרָשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êḵ tā·šîḇ ’êṯ pə·nê p̄a·ḥaṯ ’a·ḥaḏ ‘aḇ·ḏê ’ă·ḏō·nî haq·ṭan·nîm wat·tiḇ·ṭaḥ lə·ḵā ‘al- miṣ·ra·yim lə·re·ḵeḇ ū·lə·p̄ā·rā·šîm
verses.literal: For how can you repel - a single officer among the least of my master’s servants when you depend . . . on Egypt for chariots and horsemen
verses.literalPt: Como, então, poderás pôr em fuga um só capitão dos menores dos servos do meu amo e confiar no Egito para obteres cavalos e carros?

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ הֲמִבַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה עָלִ֛יתִי עַל־ הָאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּ֖את לְהַשְׁחִיתָ֑הּ יְהוָה֙ אָמַ֣ר אֵלַ֔י עֲלֵ֛ה אֶל־ הָאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּ֖את וְהַשְׁחִיתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hă·mib·bal·‘ă·ḏê Yah·weh ‘ā·lî·ṯî ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ lə·haš·ḥî·ṯāh Yah·weh ’ā·mar ’ê·lay ‘ă·lêh ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ wə·haš·ḥî·ṯāh
verses.literal: So now was it apart from the LORD that I have come up against this land to destroy it The LORD Himself said to me Go up against this land and destroy it
verses.literalPt: Porventura, subi eu, agora, sem Jeová contra esta terra para a destruir? Disse-me Jeová: Sobe contra esta terra e destrói-a.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶלְיָקִים֩ וְשֶׁבְנָ֨א וְיוֹאָ֜ח אֶל־ רַב־ שָׁקֵ֗ה דַּבֶּר־ נָ֤א אֶל־ עֲבָדֶ֙יךָ֙ אֲרָמִ֔ית כִּ֥י שֹׁמְעִ֖ים אֲנָ֑חְנוּ וְאַל־ תְּדַבֵּ֤ר אֵלֵ֙ינוּ֙ יְהוּדִ֔ית בְּאָזְנֵ֣י הָעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ הַחוֹמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’el·yā·qîm wə·šeḇ·nā wə·yō·w·’āḥ ’el- raḇ- šā·qêh dab·ber- nā ’el- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā ’ă·rā·mîṯ kî šō·mə·‘îm ’ă·nā·ḥə·nū wə·’al- tə·ḏab·bêr ’ê·lê·nū yə·hū·ḏîṯ bə·’ā·zə·nê hā·‘ām ’ă·šer ‘al- ha·ḥō·w·māh
verses.literal: Then Eliakim Shebna and Joah said to the Rabshakeh Please speak to your servants in Aramaic since we understand it Do not speak to us in Hebrew in the hearing of the people on the wall
verses.literalPt: Então, disseram Eliaquim, Sebna e Joá a Rabsaqué: Rogamos-te que fales aos teus servos na língua aramaica, pois nós a entendemos; e não nos fales na língua dos judeus aos ouvidos do povo que está em cima do muro.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר רַב־ שָׁקֵ֗ה הַאֶ֨ל אֲדֹנֶ֤יךָ וְאֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ שְׁלָחַ֣נִי אֲדֹנִ֔י לְדַבֵּ֖ר אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה הֲלֹ֣א עַל־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים הַיֹּֽשְׁבִים֙ עַל־ הַ֣חוֹמָ֔ה לֶאֱכֹ֣ל אֶת־ חַרְאֵיהֶם וְלִשְׁתּ֛וֹת אֶת־ שֵׁינֵיהֶם עִמָּכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer raḇ- šā·qêh ha·’el ’ă·ḏō·ne·ḵā wə·’ê·le·ḵā šə·lā·ḥa·nî ’ă·ḏō·nî lə·ḏab·bêr ’eṯ- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh hă·lō ‘al- hā·’ă·nā·šîm hay·yō·šə·ḇîm ‘al- ha·ḥō·w·māh le·’ĕ·ḵōl ’eṯ- ḥar·ʾē·hɛm wə·liš·tō·wṯ ’eṯ- šē·nē·hɛm ‘im·mā·ḵem
verses.literal: But the Rabshakeh replied Has my master sent me to speak these words only to you and your master and not to the men sitting on the wall who are destined with you to eat their own dung and drink their own urine
verses.literalPt: Mas Rabsaqué respondeu-lhes: Enviou-me, porventura, o meu amo ao teu amo e a ti para falar essas palavras? Não me enviou aos homens que estão sentados em cima do muro, para que, juntamente convosco, comam o seu excremento e bebam a sua urina?

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲמֹד֙ רַב־ שָׁקֵ֔ה וַיִּקְרָ֥א בְקוֹל־ גָּד֖וֹל יְהוּדִ֑ית וַיֹּ֕אמֶר שִׁמְע֗וּ אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֛י הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ הַגָּד֖וֹל מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ raḇ- šā·qêh way·yiq·rā ḇə·qō·wl- gā·ḏō·wl yə·hū·ḏîṯ way·yō·mer šim·‘ū ’eṯ- diḇ·rê ham·me·leḵ hag·gā·ḏō·wl me·leḵ ’aš·šūr
verses.literal: Then the Rabshakeh stood and called out loudly . . . in Hebrew . . . Hear the words of the great king the king of Assyria
verses.literalPt: Então, Rabsaqué se pôs em pé e, gritando em alta voz na língua dos judeus, disse: Ouvi as palavras do grande rei, do rei da Assíria.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אַל־ יַשִּׁ֥א לָכֶ֖ם חִזְקִיָּ֑הוּ כִּ֥י לֹֽא־ יוּכַ֖ל לְהַצִּ֥יל אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar ham·me·leḵ ’al- yaš·ši lā·ḵem ḥiz·qî·yā·hū kî lō- yū·ḵal lə·haṣ·ṣîl ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: This is what the king says Do not let Hezekiah deceive you for he cannot . . . deliver you
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o rei: Não vos engane Ezequias, porque não vos poderá livrar.

verses.original: וְאַל־ יַבְטַ֨ח אֶתְכֶ֤ם חִזְקִיָּ֙הוּ֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֣ה לֵאמֹ֔ר הַצֵּ֥ל יַצִּילֵ֖נוּ יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֤א תִנָּתֵן֙ הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את בְּיַ֖ד מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’al- yaḇ·ṭaḥ ’eṯ·ḵem ḥiz·qî·yā·hū ’el- Yah·weh lê·mōr haṣ·ṣêl yaṣ·ṣî·lê·nū Yah·weh lō ṯin·nā·ṯên hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ bə·yaḏ me·leḵ ’aš·šūr
verses.literal: Do not let Hezekiah . . . persuade you to trust in the LORD when he says The LORD will surely deliver us . . . this city will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria
verses.literalPt: Nem tampouco vos faça Ezequias confiar em Jeová, dizendo: Jeová, na verdade, nos livrará; esta cidade não será entregue nas mãos do rei da Assíria.

verses.original: אַֽל־ תִּשְׁמְע֖וּ אֶל־ חִזְקִיָּ֑הוּס כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֜ר הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֗וּר עֲשֽׂוּ־ אִתִּ֤י בְרָכָה֙ וּצְא֣וּ אֵלַ֔י וְאִכְל֤וּ אִישׁ־ גַּפְנוֹ֙ וְאִ֣ישׁ תְּאֵנָת֔וֹ וּשְׁת֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ מֵי־ בוֹרֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiš·mə·‘ū ’el- ḥiz·qī·yå̄·hūs kî ḵōh ’ā·mar ham·me·leḵ ’aš·šūr ‘ă·śū- ’it·tî ḇə·rā·ḵāh ū·ṣə·’ū ’ê·lay wə·’iḵ·lū ’îš- gap̄·nōw wə·’îš tə·’ê·nā·ṯōw ū·šə·ṯū ’îš mê- ḇō·w·rōw
verses.literal: Do not listen to Hezekiah for this is what the king of Assyria says Make peace with me and come out to me Then every one of you will eat from his own vine and his own fig tree and drink . . . water from his own cistern
verses.literalPt: Não deis ouvidos a Ezequias. Pois assim diz o rei da Assíria: Fazei as vossas pazes comigo e saí para mim; coma cada um de vós da sua vinha e da sua figueira e beba cada um as águas da sua cisterna;

verses.original: עַד־ בֹּאִ֕י וְלָקַחְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ כְּאַרְצְכֶ֑ם אֶ֤רֶץ דָּגָן֙ וְתִיר֔וֹשׁ אֶ֥רֶץ לֶ֖חֶם וּכְרָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ- bō·’î wə·lā·qaḥ·tî ’eṯ·ḵem ’el- ’e·reṣ kə·’ar·ṣə·ḵem ’e·reṣ dā·ḡān wə·ṯî·rō·wōš ’e·reṣ le·ḥem ū·ḵə·rā·mîm
verses.literal: until I come and take you away to a land like your own a land of grain and new wine a land of bread and vineyards
verses.literalPt: até que eu venha e vos transfira para uma terra que é semelhante a vossa terra, terra de trigo e de mosto, terra de pão e de vinho.

verses.original: פֶּן־ יַסִּ֨ית אֶתְכֶ֤ם חִזְקִיָּ֙הוּ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יְהוָ֖ה יַצִּילֵ֑נוּ הַהִצִּ֜ילוּ אֱלֹהֵ֤י הַגּוֹיִם֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־ אַרְצ֔וֹ מִיַּ֖ד מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר׃
verses.transliteration: pen- yas·sîṯ ’eṯ·ḵem ḥiz·qî·yā·hū lê·mōr Yah·weh yaṣ·ṣî·lê·nū ha·hiṣ·ṣî·lū ’ĕ·lō·hê hag·gō·w·yim ’îš ’eṯ- ’ar·ṣōw mî·yaḏ me·leḵ ’aš·šūr
verses.literal: Do not let Hezekiah mislead you when he says The LORD will deliver us Has the god of any nation ever delivered his land from the hand of the king of Assyria
verses.literalPt: Guardai-vos não vos iluda Ezequias, dizendo: Jeová nos livrará. Acaso, os deuses das nações livraram cada um a sua terra das mãos do rei da Assíria?

verses.original: אַיֵּ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י חֲמָת֙ וְאַרְפָּ֔ד אַיֵּ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י סְפַרְוָ֑יִם וְכִֽי־ הִצִּ֥ילוּ אֶת־ שֹׁמְר֖וֹן מִיָּדִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ay·yêh ’ĕ·lō·hê ḥă·māṯ wə·’ar·pāḏ ’ay·yêh ’ĕ·lō·hê sə·p̄ar·wā·yim wə·ḵî- hiṣ·ṣî·lū ’eṯ- šō·mə·rō·wn mî·yā·ḏî
verses.literal: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad Where are the gods of Sepharvaim . . . Have they delivered Samaria from my hand
verses.literalPt: Onde estão os deuses de Hamate e Arpade? Onde estão os deuses de Sefarvaim? Livraram eles de minha mão a Samaria?

verses.original: מִ֗י בְּכָל־ אֱלֹהֵ֤י הָֽאֲרָצוֹת֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁר־ הִצִּ֥ילוּ אֶת־ אַרְצָ֖ם מִיָּדִ֑י כִּֽי־ יַצִּ֧יל יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם מִיָּדִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: mî bə·ḵāl ’ĕ·lō·hê hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ hā·’êl·leh ’ă·šer- hiṣ·ṣî·lū ’eṯ- ’ar·ṣām mî·yā·ḏî kî- yaṣ·ṣîl Yah·weh ’eṯ- yə·rū·šā·lim mî·yā·ḏî
verses.literal: Who among all the gods of these lands has delivered his land from my hand How then can the LORD deliver Jerusalem from my hand
verses.literalPt: Entre todos os deuses das terras, quais são os que livraram da minha mão a sua terra, para que Jeová possa livrar da minha mão a Jerusalém?

verses.original: וַֽיַּחֲרִ֔ישׁוּ וְלֹֽא־ עָנ֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ דָּבָ֑ר כִּֽי־ מִצְוַ֨ת הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ הִ֛יא לֵאמֹ֖ר לֹ֥א תַעֲנֻֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·ḥă·rî·šū wə·lō- ‘ā·nū ’ō·ṯōw dā·ḇār kî- miṣ·waṯ ham·me·leḵ hî lê·mōr lō ṯa·‘ă·nu·hū
verses.literal: But the people remained silent and did not answer a word - for Hezekiah . . . had commanded Do not answer him
verses.literalPt: Eles, porém, se calaram e não lhe responderam palavra. Pois o rei ordenou, dizendo: Não lhe respondais.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א אֶלְיָקִ֣ים בֶּן־ חִלְקִיָּ֣הוּ אֲשֶׁר־ עַל־ הַ֠בַּיִת וְשֶׁבְנָ֨א הַסּוֹפֵ֜ר וְיוֹאָ֨ח בֶּן־ אָסָ֧ף הַמַּזְכִּ֛יר אֶל־ חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ קְרוּעֵ֣י בְגָדִ֑ים וַיַּגִּ֣ידוּ ל֔וֹ אֵ֖ת דִּבְרֵ֥י רַב־ שָׁקֵֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ’el·yā·qîm ben- ḥil·qî·yā·hū ’ă·šer- ‘al- hab·ba·yiṯ wə·šeḇ·nā has·sō·w·p̄êr wə·yō·w·’āḥ ben- ’ā·sāp̄ ham·maz·kîr ’el- ḥiz·qî·yā·hū qə·rū·‘ê ḇə·ḡā·ḏîm way·yag·gî·ḏū lōw ’êṯ diḇ·rê raḇ- šā·qêh
verses.literal: Then Hilkiah’s son Eliakim the palace administrator Shebna the scribe and Asaph’s son Joah the recorder came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn and they relayed to him the words of the Rabshakeh
verses.literalPt: Então, Eliaquim, filho de Hilquias, mordomo, e Sebna, secretário, e Joá, filho de Asafe, cronista-mor, vieram ter com Ezequias, rasgados os vestidos, e lhe referiram as palavras de Rabsaqué.
